G01.isolation_note: MAINS (ac_l_in, l_f/l_filt, ac_n_in, n_filt, led/ZC taps, tco_l/blw_l are their own potential groups behind fuses) plus PE. Rectifier outputs rect_p/rect_n are separate HOT potential groups (3.2 mm functional). Barrier: every HOT net to SELV/PE 8.0 mm (rules21.BARRIER, D5); C3/C4 Y1 caps and J6 are the HOT-to-PE bridges (PE branch >= 8.0 mm from all HOT, D5-BASIS.md); J1 pads see 8 mm to SELV.
findings: F10 EMI module has no MPN (DM >= 100 uH assumed; D-22 as specified fails by 5.1 dB)
F5 leakage FAIL 0.974 mA vs 0.5 mA: Y total must drop to <= 5.0 nF/line (board 2.2 nF + module 6.9 nF; DECISIONS 22)
F2/DECISIONS 22: BR1 (GBJ2510, 510 A2s) cannot survive F1 clearing (1,710 A2s); declared sacrificial
F11 Y-cap PE path 75-81 mm (~125 nH) and J6 placement; re-spin item
F12 L1 modelled at 1.23 W (c28) vs ~2.0-2.7 W real at 15 A; L1 zero stock, 29 wk (F13)
F13 BP-07 restraint callouts for C1/C2, L1, RV1; J1 UL use group unchecked; C3/C4 JLC stock 6 pcs (LOW_JLC_STOCK); J6 1704004 zero stock
F1 KLDR025.TXP: no LCSC code / single source, $29.41 at 500 (12.7 % of board parts cost)

improvement_angles.angle: Cheaper (largest single line on the board, $29.41 at 500 = 12.7 %): F1 KLDR025.TXP 25 A fuse (single-source, no LCSC code, hand-assembled) - a cheaper/stocked fuse or a smaller rating
improvement_angles.disturbs: F1's clearing I2t (1,710 A2s) is the reference for the copper-neck target (3,420 A2s = 2x) in G02/G08, for BR1 survival (510 A2s) and for F2 coordination in G10 (F2 melts at 11.6 A2s); rating must stay above the 22-28 A tank current plus L1 inrush and below the breaker/enclosure limit

improvement_angles.angle: Cheaper/available: replace L1 (TDK B82726S2203A020, 0 stock, $9.88) with an in-stock DM/CM choke or fold it into the inlet module
improvement_angles.disturbs: L1 sits in the l_filt/n_filt path ahead of BR1: changes EMI margin (G01/offboard module), leakage if Y moves, and B3 heat near C5/C6/PS2 (G02, G06)

improvement_angles.angle: Cheaper: drop RV1 or C1/C2 X2 pair size if the inlet module carries X; R1/R2 bleeders are then redundant
improvement_angles.disturbs: Surge clamp is what protects BR1/C5/C6 (G02) and the TVS stack sees less; X bleed time must still meet touch-voltage rule

improvement_angles.angle: Better margin: reduce Y (C3/C4 2.2 nF -> <= 1 nF) to pass leakage
improvement_angles.disturbs: Raises CM impedance: coil-PE CM EMI margin (10.5 dB) in G04/G01 and SELV earth strap R38 (G10); PS1/PS2 module Y caps are fixed leakage in G10/G06

improvement_angles.angle: Better: replace GBJ2510 (THT, sink-mounted, 25 A) with a part that survives F1 clearing, or accept sacrificial and drop fault-copper ask
improvement_angles.disturbs: BR1 pin order fixes the rectifier/link routing (FLOORPLAN stage 3); the sink row order; fusing-ratio metric couples to G02 copper necks

findings: F2/DECISIONS 22: fuse_copper_fusing_ratio 0.208 (R5->J10 HV_RET neck 1.17 mm, 355 A2s vs 1,710) - needs >= 2x (3,420 A2s); J8->Q2/Q5 drains 884 A2s

F12 C5/C6 12.6 K rise vs 9.8 K allowed (27 K margin per converged B3, bench IR)

improvement_angles.angle: Better margin: widen HV_RET / BUS_P necks to 3,420 A2s - the first fix candidate against the benchmark

improvement_angles.angle: Cheaper/available: JLC-stocked DC-link film (or fewer/larger) alternatives to the two hand-assembled TDK B32676G1905K000 (19 uF, $12.34 at 500 for the pair)

improvement_angles.angle: Cheaper (the two 30KPA150CA TVS are $19.64 of this group's $42.94 and are hand-assembled): replace the TVS stack with a stocked clamp or drop it if RV1 plus bank limit the bus
improvement_angles.disturbs: D3/D17 define the bus surge limit protecting BR1/FETs/C5-C6 and the tank over-voltage story (F3); busbleed_mid is its own potential group with R3/R4 (2 x 220k), which also bleed the bus (touch-voltage discharge)

G10.isolation_note: SELV (J4, v3v3, v15_selv, selv_gnd, PWM/permit/ct/vbus signals) with PE strap R38 (0 ohm, SELV earthed); PS1 (IRM-20-15) straddles the barrier (MAINS in, SELV out) and F2/J11 are the blw_l MAINS group (F2 can open). 8.0 mm to every HOT net.
findings: F4 F2 breaking capacity FAIL: UMT 250 at 200 A vs 0.37-3.6 kA at J11; needs >= 1,500 A 5x20 (02153.15MXP lead) or remove the blower tap
F11 J4 has 3 ground pins for 12 signals, ct_mon across from pwm_la, unfiltered PWM; re-pin needs controller change (re-spin)
F9 closed pwm_ha/pwm_la with C153-C156 reference-transfer caps (19b/19c)
F5 R38 0 ohm earths SELV: PS1 leakage reaches PE; IRM-20-15 0.43 mA datasheet max shared
F13 PS1 IRM-20-15 ZERO_DK_STOCK 17 wk; F2 3403.0171 no LCSC; J11 B2P3-VH consign; J4 only stocked at LCSC 7797

improvement_angles.angle: Simpler/safer: delete the blower tap (F2 + J11 + PS3 off-board) and run the blower from the controller supply
improvement_angles.disturbs: Fixes F4 breaking capacity; but DECISIONS 15/16 chose the separate PS3 to stop blower start from browning out the controller; touches 12 V rail budget on the controller board

improvement_angles.angle: Cheaper/available: swap PS1 IRM-20-15 for a stocked 15 V module or derive v15_selv from PS2/IRM-60
improvement_angles.disturbs: PS1 supplies v15_selv to the controller through J4; it straddles the barrier on the SELV spur and sets with PS2 the module Y/leakage (F5); R38 earths SELV

improvement_angles.angle: Better: re-pin J4 with interleaved grounds and add RC at PWM inputs
improvement_angles.disturbs: Controller board LAYOUT J4 and R44 harness must change together (F11); return-path gate assertions
